Enrolling as a first-year. Exam today.
Retired in 1970. Visiting the archive.
Taking my grandchildren to the shelter.
Starting my first professorship in the city.
Resigned. My students were a burden.
Hurrying to church. Faith will save us.
Reopening the faculty. Full lectures tomorrow.
Bachelor, no dependents. Back to my room.
Good day, officer. Back from the university archives, to steady my students.
Stoicism is the only logical response to a crisis, wouldn't you agree?
The books are starting to feel… heavy. As if the ink is rotting.
I saw a bird fall from the sky today. It didn't even scream.
The fire is a beautiful editor. It deletes all our mistakes.
Why check the papers? Soon the ash will be our only record.
Thank you. Stay focused. Order is our only defense.
Go home, officer. While there’s still a home to go to.
Enter the tomb, officer. It’s warmer than the street.
Observed. Contained. The scientific method applied to the scientist. How fitting.
A cage for a man who has already let everything go. Symmetry.
Reduce. Simplify. Erase. Yes… that is the correct theorem.
One more variable… removed… zero is the only true answer…
Where are you coming from?
The archive, pulling first editions from the dust. Then my ethics lecture.
The university. The lab wing cracked. I still lectured. Eleven came.
The empty faculty. I left my lecture notes. No reason to carry them.
The chemistry laboratory. Fifteen years teaching organic chemistry there.
My flat. I cancelled all lectures weeks ago. Routine is for the unreflective.
Faculty housing. I live alone. Never married. My soundest decision.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
Headaches, occasionally. I have always had them. Nothing for the polyclinic.
I lose track of time. I look up and it is dark.
A taste of copper in the mouth. Two weeks now. I no longer mind.
None. A disciplined mind has never once permitted a headache.
Nothing. At twenty-eight one recovers quickly. I sleep well, wake rested.
Nothing. I resigned last year for my health. It has improved since.
My students ask what comes next. I tell them history. They dislike it.
Order is its own kind of courage, officer. You are practicing it now.
Human intellect is a very fragile glass, and the hammer is coming.
I lectured an empty hall yesterday. Habit is the skeleton of civilization.
Why check papers? Soon the ash will be the only record anyone keeps.
